DocAligner LCNet100 heatmap document-corner model, FP32, 256 x 256 input.
Project: https://github.com/DocsaidLab/DocAligner
Reference revision: 3275b0f07f8e99d8c01cb0774dea2549be1416b6
Author: DocsaidLab / Ze Yuan. License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).
Upstream model: lcnet100_h_e_bifpn_256_fp32.onnx
Downloaded without modification from the official Google Drive file:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IlbLPkCv-TdaBLOPh_4J97P1_KHYYJ7a/view
File renamed for cache versioning only; weights are unmodified.
SHA256: f4117b786e3a18470f3865c93f3c2bd69d9b998edd60f385574a5c665e79594e
Size: 4767987 bytes.
Input: img, [1, 3, 256, 256], float32 BGR / 255, stretch resize.
Output: heatmap, [1, 4, 128, 128], float32 probabilities.
Post-processing is an original TypeScript implementation: threshold 0.3,
largest 8-connected region per channel, intensity-weighted cell-center centroid,
minimum component peak 0.6, diffuse-region and convexity checks.
This differs from the upstream resized-mask geometric contour centroid.
Thresholds are experimental; peak activation is not a calibrated probability
that the corners are correct. No OCR model is included.
